name: Professional Ethics and Human Values
topics: Morals, Values, Ethics and Work Ethics
Define morals, values and ethics and explain their relationship with examples.
Explain work ethics including caring, sharing, honesty, valuing time, cooperation, commitment, empathy and self-confidence.
Religion, Vedas, Spirituality and Indian Values
Explain the concept of religion and human values with examples; can the world have one religion?
Explain Indian values in the framework of the Vedas, spirituality, purushartha and nishkama karma.
Professional Ethics and Work–Life Balance (Case-based)
'Professional ethics and human values are highly relevant today.' Support this with an example of a company that promotes work–life balance.
Analyse the given workplace case (e.g., employee caring for an ill parent, accountant discovering fraud) and explain how you would act ethically.
Moral Dilemmas and Ethical Decision Making
What is a moral dilemma? Enumerate the steps in confronting a moral dilemma with examples.
Analyse the given situational dilemma (beggar snatching a wallet / reporting corruption) and justify your action.
Theories of Moral Development: Kohlberg and Gilligan
Explain Kohlberg's theory of moral development and its limitations/critiques.
Explain Gilligan's theory; differentiate justice-based and care-based morality.
Ethical Theories and Feminist Ethics
Explain rights-based and duty-based ethical theories and differentiate them with examples; outline the history and classification of ethical theories.
Why is feminist ethics important in the 21st century? Explain feminist consequentialism.
Profession, Professionalism and Codes of Ethics
Differentiate between profession and professionalism; explain the responsibilities and expectations of a professional.
Explain the code of ethics for engineers and unethical practices in engineering; explain training and skill sets of engineers.
Engineering as Experimentation, Safety and Risk
Explain 'engineering as social experimentation' and engineers' responsibility for safety and risk; explain risk–benefit analysis.
Discuss the ethical issues, causes and lessons of the Bhopal gas tragedy / Challenger / Fukushima / Three Mile Island disasters.
Rights: IPR, Human Rights and Employee Rights
What are intellectual property rights? Why are they necessary? Illustrate how IPR protects a product.
Explain human rights and employee rights and the right to professional judgement.
Corporate Social Responsibility
Define CSR and explain two models (e.g., Carroll's model); evaluate the CSR initiatives of a company.
Is CSR evolving to meet new needs? Discuss its role in integrated social growth.
Computer, Business, Environmental and Research Ethics
Describe computer ethics, its significance and related issues.
Write short notes on business ethics, environmental ethics and research ethics.
Empathy, Knowledge Sharing and Time Management
Write notes on sympathy vs empathy, sharing and caring, and normative enquiry.
What is knowledge sharing and how would you create such an environment? Explain techniques of time management.
